name: fire-duck-ext-wasm-validation
description: WASM validation tests for the fire_duck_ext DuckDB extension

scripts.validate: node validate_wasm_module.mjs && node validate_wasm_functional.mjs && node validate_wasm_browser.mjs

comment: @duckdb/duckdb-wasm must bundle the same DuckDB MINOR as the extension build. 1.33.1-dev110.0 bundles DuckDB v2.0.0 (d54cbbe3df), the version MainDistributionPipeline.yml builds; the DuckDB 1.5 leg of wasm-validation.yml installs 1.33.1-dev57.0 (DuckDB 1.5.4) over it. Stable releases still bundle 1.4.x. Check what a version bundles with: node -e "...getVersion()" (see README.md).
